Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. As part of our procurement review I need to collect a small package of artifacts and a short written confirmation that Redwood will host Meditrust workloads exclusively in EU-region infrastructure for the pilot (no cross-border failover). Our security team is specifically asking for: 

- A one-page attestation that production workloads for account "Meditrust" will only run in EU regions (list the region(s) and fallback behaviour).
- Current SOC 2 summary / system boundaries (redacted where necessary).
- Completed CAIQ (our assessors will review).
- SIG or equivalent questionnaire responses for network controls; if full SIG is large, a condensed export is fine.
- Short description of VPC/private endpoint setup, peering options, and KMS key ownership/partitioning.

We'd like to get the package by EOD Thursday (29 Jul) to keep the calendar for the pilot onboarding. If any of these require an NDA/softer redaction process, let me know.

Thanks,
